provenance.source: V2 SAMPLE fixture — Phase R3-V2 Stage A schema plumbing. Synthetic, well-formed v2 superset: the v1 axes plus all three sister-proposed blocks (mass_model / occurrence_by_metallicity / intra_system_correlation) and the app-side feh_dist axis. NOT research-calibrated values — a shape fixture. Real v2 numbers come from Packet 3.5 when v2 is scheduled.
provenance.description: Used to prove the validator/provider/importer accept and expose the v2 blocks. No engine reads them in Stage A, so this fixture does not change generation output.

mass_model.notes: M_iso(sigma, a, Mstar) via the Group P calculators (F2/F3/F6); the engine samples from this in Stage B.

occurrence_by_metallicity.n_planet_dist_shift: scale n_planet_dist toward higher counts with [Fe/H]

intra_system_correlation.ordering: outer planets modestly larger in ~65% of pairs
intra_system_correlation.note: once a seed planet is drawn, neighbours are drawn CONDITIONAL on it, not independently.

planet_at_location:in_situ_beyond_snow.pathway: in-situ accretion beyond the snow line

trojan:feasible.pathway: in-situ co-accretion / capture into the Lagrange point

trojan:infeasible.pathway: no stable co-orbital pathway (host too massive)

resonance:infeasible.pathway: would require migration / capture into resonance
